description: Portfolio standard for repos whose CI runs on pull requests: Renovate merges its own non-major PRs once the checks are green. Majors and repos without a PR-triggered workflow stay manual.

packageRules.description: Green CI is the safety net - let Renovate merge non-major updates itself. platformAutomerge is off on purpose: without a required status check GitHub refuses to arm auto-merge on an already-clean PR, which is exactly why the backlog piled up.
